description: This is a set of test cases for the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator component, specifically testing the validation and parsing of system run commands. It defines test functions to verify command matching, error handling, and fixture loading, as well as functions to locate fixture files. The code uses the XCTest framework for testing, with custom expectations and issue recording.

methods.name: matches shared system run command contract fixture
methods.description: Tests matching of command against expected output and error conditions, using loadContractCases() to retrieve test data.

methods.name: validator keeps canonical wrapper text out of allowlist raw parsing
methods.description: Verifies that the validator correctly handles raw commands with canonical text.

methods.name: env dash shell wrapper requires canonical raw command binding
methods.description: Tests the handling of env dash shell commands for matching raw command strings and validation.

methods.name: loadContractCases
methods.description: Loads test cases from a JSON fixture file, decoding into an array of SystemRunCommandContractCase.

methods.name: findContractFixtureURL
methods.description: Locates the fixture JSON file for system run command contract tests by traversing up the directory tree.
